title: PsyEval: A Suite of Mental Health Related Tasks for Evaluating Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating large language models on mental health-related tasks, including knowledge, diagnosis, and emotional support.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the research.
